content: Is Penenawag te Ked-iniyug te Kelelalung
Menge etew te Israel, pemineǥa niw heini is mekeseseeng he kebpenhulùhulù mehitenged keniyu:

content.text: Is Israel he iring te vahi he wazè pa mekeremaǥi, nezeetan ne kenè en heini ebpekeuman ebpekeenew.
Mibey-anan sikandin diyà te tanè din

content: Umbe, migkaǥi is Nengazen he MEGBEVAYÀ te, “Dutun te 1,000 he menge sundaru he edsuǥuen puun te sevaha he inged te Israel, 100 dà is egkesamà. Ne is edsuǥuen he 100 he menge sundaru, 10 dà is egkesamà.
Umbe, dangep kew kayi te kedì, is menge etew te Israel, su wey kew meuyag-uyag.
Kenè kew en hendiyà te Betel, te Gilgal, etawa te Beersheba te ked-azap. Su siguradu he ebihaǥen is menge etew ziyà te Gilgal, ne egkahanew is Betel.
Sikiyu is menge kevuwazan ni Jose, dangep kew kayi te kediey su wey kew meuyag-uyag. Su emun kenà, ne edsurungen ku sikiyu he iring a te hapuy. Umbe egkezeetan is Betel ne wazè en ebpekeeǥen kayi.
Ne mekehizuhizu kew! Is meupiya wey hustu he kukuman, midhimu niw he mezaat ne wazè niw veliya is metazeng.”

Is Megbevayà iyan midlimbag te menge grupu te menge vituen he migngezanan te Penikapan wey Belatic. Iyan sikandin mibpedliwà te merusirem wey merayag, wey maandew wey mezukilem. Iyan sikandin midtiǥum te wahig te zaǥat diyà te menge gapun ne ibpeuzan din heini ziyà te tanà. Is ngazan din iyan is Nengazen.
Kandin he ketau is kegketik-ew kegkezeeti te pengalang te inged, ne edweǥayen din is miberengbeng he inged.
Sikiyu is menge tig-Israel, egkepeukan niw is edhukum te hustu wey egkaǥi te tutuu ziyà te hukmanan.

Midaagdaag niw is menge pubri ne midteǥel niw he mebeǥey ziyà te keniyu te neraǥun dan. Umbe kenè niw en egkeubpaan is dezekelà he menge valey he mibangun niw, wey kenè kew en ebpekeinum te vinu he ebpuun diyà te impemula niw he menge paras.

Su netuenan ku ke sengemenu kahabet wey ke sengemenu kezekelà is menge salè niw. Edèdaaǥen niw is menge etew he wazà mekesalà ne mibpenepian niw pa. Wazè niw veǥayi te hustu he kukuman diyà te hukmanan is menge pubri.
Umbe, tenged te kezaat te ulaula te menge etew kayi he timpu, is menge etew he nekesavut te egkesuatan te Megbevayà ebpereremek en.
Guntaan, beeli niw is meupiya ne kenà is mezaat su wey kew meuyag-uyag ne ebpekiduma keniyu is Nengazen he Megbevayà he Mekeǥeǥehem sumalà is egkeǥiyen niw he zuma niw sikandin.

Senggilahi niw is mezaat ne veeli niw is meupiya, ne hukum kew te hustu ziyà te hukmanan. Su kela ke mehizuwi kew zed te Nengazen he Megbevayà he Mekeǥeǥehem is nengesamà keniyu te menge kevuwazan ni Jose.

Su iyan heini migkaǥi te Nengazen he Megbevayà he Mekeǥeǥehem: “Egkeuma is timpu he zuen ebpemenineǥew wey ebpemen-erang diyà te menge zalan niw wey menge pelasa. Is menge perevasuk ibpetawag su wey zan mesineǥawi is menge minatey zuma te menge etew he edsuhulan wey mekesineǥew.
Duen daan ebpemenineǥew ziyà te menge pemuleey niw te paras. Egkehitavù heini ziyà te keniyu su edsilutan ku sikiyu. Iyan a, is Nengazen, is migkaǥi kayi.”
Is Andew te Kedhukum te Megbevayà
Kehizu niw te edtaǥad te kegkeuma te andew te Nengazen. Kenè niw isipa he andew heeyan te kegkelibri niw, kekenà, andew heeyan te kedsiluti keniyu.

Egkeiring kew te etew he egkeisip din he nelibri en sikandin su nepeleǥuyan din en is erimaung, piru bir ves is egkesinuǥung din. Etawa egkeisip din he wazè en ebpekekaid kandin su ziyè en sikandin te seled te valey zin, piru ked-ulembè din diyà te elavat ne migkaǥat is belad din te uled.
Benar he is andew te Nengazen ebpekeuwit te silut ne kenà kelibriyanan; iring heini te merusirem he wazè en duen bulug deisey he kerayag.
Is Egkesuatan te Megbevayà he Beeli te menge Etew Zin
“Egkeepesan ku is menge pista niw; wazè ku ikelipey is menge ketiǥuman niw.
Umbe, minsan uwiti e pa keniyu te nekedseselekawà he menge pemuhat, minsan iyan pa is kineupiyahan he pemuhat, kenè ku heeyan edewaten.
Engkezi niw en is meǥurub he menge kanta niw. Kenà a egkesuat he ebpemineg te sunata te menge alpa niw.
Piru ipeehè niw is hustu he kukuman ne veeli niw is metazeng; kenè niw heini engkezi iring te wahig he kenà ed-engked he edtudà.
“Sikiyu is menge etew te Israel, hein seled te 40 he tuig diyà te sibsivayan is menge kepuun niw, nemuhat be sikandan kayi te kedì? Wazà!
Ne ǥuntaan edtulungan niw ed-uwita si Sakut, kes ed-ezapen he mid-isip niw he hadì niw, wey si Kaywan, kes ed-ezapen niw he vituen. Mibeelan niw heini he menge ledawan su ed-ezapen niw.
Umbe, ibpevihag ku sikiyu ziyà te hunaan pa te Damascus.” Iyan heini migkaǥi te Nengazen he migngezanan te Megbevayà he Mekeǥeǥehem.
